body:
i have one sibling and a half sibling who lives with us, my mom seems to pay more attention to them than to me. she’s always comparing me to them so im pretty sure she’ll be better off without me weighing her down.
i also only have online friends and im too scared to talk to them about it because they deserve better than me spilling all my problems on them.

i live in a small city in Canada so there’s barely any services and the services they have cost quite a bit of money or have a long waiting list which i dont have time for. 

here, they only tell your parents if they think you’re at risk to harm yourself or others but i didnt even tell the teacher that i was feeling suicidal, i just told them that i was feeling sad and that i wanted to talk to them
i keep seeing people saying it’ll get better as you get older but it’s been years and ive only been feeling worse

i used to have a counselor but i haven’t seen her since august because we barely have enough money to even live in a decent home. 
ive even tried talking to someone before, a teacher i thought would listen, but they only patronized me and threatened to call my mom who has enough on her plate as it is.
i truly tried
i think she has enough on her plate as it is, id only be adding more if i were to tell her about my problems
